title: Store-Delay Credit for Late-Delivery Disputes (Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts)
content:
**Clause.** Under Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts, the store-delay credit in a late-delivery dispute counts the rating exclusions granted on the disputed violation's batch for the reason "store delay": 2 or more give a store-delay credit of 2 points; exactly one gives 1 point; none gives no credit.

The exclusions counted are those already granted on the account for ratings on that batch with the reason store delay; exclusions for other reasons do not count.

| Store-delay rating exclusions on the batch | Store-delay credit |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 points |
| Exactly 1 | 1 point |
| None | None |

## Cases (hypothetical batches)

- A Triple Delivery Batch on which two ratings were excluded for store delay: 2 points.
- A Double Delivery Batch with one store-delay exclusion and one app-outage exclusion: 1 point.
- A batch with no exclusions: no credit.
